summary: Daily todo list app with passive-aggressive unchecking behavior
known_issues: Cannot add new tasks to the todo list (add functionality broken)
Todo items do not persist across page refreshes (backend persistence not working)

existing_features.title: Create a clean daily todo list interface where users can add new tasks with a text input and submit button
Display all todo items in a list with checkboxes, where each item shows the task text and can be toggled between checked and unchecked states
When a task is checked off, display it with normal styling (e.g., strikethrough or completed state)
When a task is unchecked, immediately change the task text color to red
When a task is unchecked, display a popup modal with a randomly generated passive-aggressive insult about the user's work ethic
Apply a creative, coherent visual theme to the todo list interface with a distinct style including color palette, typography, and layout that is consistently enforced throughout
Add an edit button or inline edit trigger for each task in the TodoList component that allows users to modify the task text
Create a React Query mutation hook in useQueries.ts for updating task text that calls the backend update function
Add a dark mode toggle button in the application header that allows users to switch between light and dark color schemes
Store the user's dark mode preference in localStorage so it persists across browser sessions and is applied immediately on page load
When a user deletes a task without checking it off first, display a passive-aggressive modal roast about deleting incomplete tasks
When a user adds a new task and immediately checks it off without delay, display a passive-aggressive modal roast questioning whether they actually did the task
Debug and fix the task addition functionality in the TodoInput component so users can successfully add new tasks to the todo list
Verify that the frontend correctly loads persisted tasks on initial page load by calling getAllTasks and rendering them in the TodoList component

new_feature_requests.summary: Normal behavior when checking off tasks
Turn task text red when unchecking
Show popup with passive-aggressive insult about work ethic when unchecking
Store the list of todos and their checked/unchecked states in the backend so they persist across sessions
Add ability to edit task text to fix typos or update content
Update the backend main.mo actor to include a function that updates the text of an existing task by its ID
Add dark mode to reduce eye strain
Implement dark mode styling by applying the 'dark' class to the html or body element and ensuring all components respect the existing dark mode OKLCH color variables defined in index.css
Show passive-aggressive roast when user deletes a task without checking it off first
Show passive-aggressive roast when user adds a task and immediately checks it off (questioning if they actually did it)
Ensure the dark mode preference persists across browser sessions by verifying localStorage is correctly saving and loading the user's theme selection
Implement backend persistence for todo items so that all tasks and their checked/unchecked states are stored in stable memory and survive canister upgrades
Create a migration.mo file to safely upgrade the backend state from the current Map-based storage to stable storage without data loss
